scope: PYTHON SIDE ONLY. The Rust implementation is not exercised and is not verified by this trace. This is black-box evidence over the real HTTP, WebSocket and protobuf surface of the reference application.

capture.method: agent-browser drives the UI; HTTP requests and WebSocket frames are read from the Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint of the same browser instance
capture.end_condition: the last script_finished frame plus the final DOM observation; the long-lived Streamlit WebSocket is never waited on for EOF

upload_contract.session_id_and_file_id: opaque lookup keys taken from the path
upload_contract.field_name: not significant: the upstream server takes the single UploadFile present in the multipart form, so any field name works
upstream_errors: 400 'Expected 1 file, but got N' when the form does not carry exactly one file
413 'File too large' when the file exceeds the per-file size limit

superseded_attempts.what: the first capture, whose per-step DOM observations were empty
superseded_attempts.reason: the DOM observation JavaScript was mangled by shell escaping, so every observation returned an empty object; the frame capture itself was valid
superseded_attempts.action: overwritten by the corrected capture; no duplicate bundle kept

superseded_attempts.what: the second capture, which had the DOM observations but no per-command exit codes
superseded_attempts.reason: C-P0-04 requires the capture commands AND their exit codes in the trace
superseded_attempts.action: overwritten by the final capture; no duplicate bundle kept

not_measured.why: a reconnect sends a third subprotocol entry (the session id); this capture only observed a fresh page load, which sends two entries. The reconnect case is declared as not_run in tests/journeys/interface-diff.json (W11) and is not presented as observed.
the capture uploaded a CSV, not media, so the route was never exercised; the case stays not_run (W05).

not_measured.item: the form submit and the two-session and reconnect scenarios
not_measured.why: the capture covers the reference application's interaction points for the P0 closed loop (startup, upload, selector, slider, checkbox, pulse). The form submit, the two-session isolation and the reconnect scenarios have no trace yet and their journeys stay not_run.
